title: Show HN: Properties to rent - No agent fees, no dead listings, no risk

items.summary: Really nice site. UK needs something like this, especially in this market.
Can't search for 1 bedroom, not a studio flat.
Excellent domain and the website looks nice. Can you give us some background about the technology used?

I love it! Estate agents in London are a royal pain. If this gets rid of them I will be extremely grateful.
Distance units in Kilometres are confusing for a UK site.
Typo on FAQ page: 'burdon' instead of 'burden'.
Front page doesn't clearly describe the service. Needs improvement.
Map on the search page is not collapsible and causes flashing screen.
Zooming out on the map should increase search distance.
